data.title: Unit 8: Force, tools, and machines
Types of force
data.heading: Gravity
data.rubric: Click on the rocket to make it escape Earth's gravity.
data.text: Gravity is the force that pulls all objects towards the centre of the Earth.
The strength of the force of gravity is different for different objects; the larger the object, the greater its pull.
All objects fall to Earth at exactly the same speed even though the force of gravity works differently on each.
The Earth's force of gravity is the strongest.
Objects can escape gravity by moving at a very fast speed and maintaining that same speed.
If they slow down, they will be pulled back.
